overall_description: A traditional woodworking leg vise with a wide flat screw-threaded face jaw pivoting outward from a guide pin at the bottom, an iron parallel guide rod running through the jaw and a fixed block below the bench edge, and a large-diameter threaded screw with a turned wooden handle driving the jaw. The jaw slides on the parallel rod while the screw drives it open and closed, and the bench apron has a captured nut housing for the screw.
